svg.text: Which decision model sets the map right?
stac-zap field test: 30 map requests, 6 settings. Each cell is the percent of answers the app applies correctly.
The model's API takes fewer options than the question has (up to 250 collections)
Tested on 2 October 2026. One question per call. Overall counts rejected questions as wrong.
A small test of one app, not a benchmark. Code and data: github.com/developmentseed/stac-zap (eval/)
